ownership.Main: All Unity execution, scene edits, source-opening integration, platform/plaza/metro connection, movement/render verification. Main removes obsolete synthetic hall when replacing.

builderContract: Standalone AgentScripts C# compiled via unity run_script, public static void Main(string[] args). Each script self-contained helpers; owns only its root (영상복원 · 1층 or 영상복원 · 2층) and its separate art directory. Use Unity Editor API for assets/scene; never raw YAML. Build while in Edit mode; reusable/idempotent. Main runs scripts after all editing. No agents run Unity, builds, tests, formatters or validation.
assetReuse: Reuse existing StationInterior/PBR textures, Materials, Props/*.fbx and Reused escalator prefab/profile; existing research/ contains broad downloaded OSS asset search. Structural mesh custom extrusion is allowed after checking reuse. No plain primitive stand-ins where an acquired actual prop exists. No blank storefront boxes or people photo billboards.
quality: Actual geometry, openings and usable collision; recessed shop interiors with reused furniture and lighting; correct text signs, glass muntins/doors, handrails and tread details; no stubs, scene-breaking guessed references, teleport links, or fabricated completion claims. All new dimensions not obtained from SfM/source are explicit inference. Keep allocations bounded/batch static meshes. Main alone tunes global light/post.
